pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū paṇītabhojanāni attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā paṇītabhojanāni . . . bhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:1.5: kassa sampannaṃ na manāpaṃ, kassa sāduṃ na ruccatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū . . . bhuñjissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:1.15.1: yāni kho pana tāni paṇītabhojanāni seyyath' īdaṃ sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ maccho maṃsaṃ khīraṃ dadhi, yo pana bhikkhu evarūpāni paṇītabhojanāni attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:1.16: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gilānā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:2.2: gilānapucchakā bhikkhū gilāne bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:2.3: kacc' āvuso khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:2.4: pubbe mayaṃ āvuso paṇītabhojanāni attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjāma, tena no phāsu hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:2.5: idāni pana bhagavatā paṭikkhittan ti kukkuccāyantā na viññāpema, tena no na phāsu hotīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:2.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:2.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā paṇītabhojanāni attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:2.9: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:2.10.1: yāni kho pana tāni paṇītabhojanāni seyyath' īdaṃ sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ maccho maṃsaṃ khīraṃ dadhi, yo pana bhikkhu evarūpāni paṇītabhojanāni agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:3.1.3: gosappi vā ajikāsappi vā māhisaṃ vā sappi, yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappati tesaṃ sappi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:3.1.17: gokhīraṃ vā ajikākhīraṃ vā māhisakhīraṃ vā, yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappati tesaṃ khīraṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:3.1.29: yassa vinā paṇītabhojanāni na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:3.1.30: agilāno attano atthāya viññāpeti, payoge payoge dukkaṭaṃ;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc39:3.2.1: agilāno agilānasaññī paṇītabhojanāni attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
